The kernel compiles, passes all correctness checks, and delivers a solid speedup:

| Metric | Result |
|--------|--------|
| Compiled | true |
| Correctness | 5/5 trials passed |
| Runtime (mean) | 5.60 ms |
| Reference runtime | 8.95 ms |
| Speedup | **~1.6×** |

The kernel maps each 16×16 output tile to a 256-thread block, with the grid z-axis iterating over the flattened batch×channel space. Each thread computes one output element by accumulating 9 MACs (3×3 kernel) from global memory, converting BF16 inputs to FP32 for accumulation, then writing back as BF16. The weights are tiny per-channel (9 BF16 values), so L1 cache absorbs the repeated reads naturally.
